paper.title: Interferometric Single-Shot Parity Measurement in InAs-Al Hybrid Devices

result.summary: 本文在 InAs-Al 异质结门定义纳米线中实现了对费米子宇称的单次干涉测量，作为迈向基于测量操作的拓扑量子计算的一步 [abstract][S1.p3]。器件由邻近化纳米线与量子点构成干涉仪，通过量子电容探测宇称，观测到 h/2e 周期的双模随机电报信号 [abstract][S3.p3]。在约 2 T 面内磁场下，两个宇称态的驻留时间超过 1 ms，对应约 3 µm 分离的 Majorana 零能模和低准粒子毒化率 [abstract]。作者据此估计宇称测量误差概率约为 1% [abstract][S5.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是实现对 Majorana 零能模共享费米子宇称的单次干涉测量，这是测量型拓扑量子计算的基本操作 [abstract][S1.p2]。原文指出，此前已有工作报道了 Aharonov-Bohm 干涉仪中门定义纳米线岛的相干输运，但其工作区间不允许量子比特读出 [S1.p2]。作者认为该测量验证了拓扑量子计算的一个必要要素 [S1.p3]。

evidence.quote: The fusion of non-Abelian anyons or topological defects is a fundamental operation in measurement-only topological quantum computation.

Progress in this direction was made in Ref., which reported coherent transport through a gate-defined nanowire island in an Aharonov-Bohm interferometer, albeit in a regime that does not allow qubit readout.
In this paper, we demonstrate an interferometric measurement of the parity of a near-zero-energy state in a 1D nanowire, thereby validating a necessary ingredient of topological quantum computation.

method.text: 器件由可调至一维拓扑超导态的纳米线和用于干涉环耦合 Majorana 零能模的量子点组成，纳米线基于门控超导体-半导体异质结 [S2.p1]。测量通过色散栅极传感探测与纳米线耦合的量子点的量子电容，从而单次确定费米子宇称 [S1.p3]。作者还建立了包含 rf 驱动功率、电荷噪声和温度的量子动力学模拟，并给出量子电容随总费米子宇称 Z 和相位 φ 变化的解析表达式 [S3.p4]。

evidence.quote: The first component is a nanowire, sections of which can be tuned into a 1DTS state, leading to topological degeneracy of the many-body ground state.
The second component consists of quantum dots, which are designed to couple pairs of MZMs in an interferometric loop.

The measurement technique is based on probing the quantum capacitance $C_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle Q}}$ of a quantum dot coupled to the nanowire and allows determination of the parity in a single shot ( Fig. 1), with a probability of assignment errors of $1\%$ for optimal measurement time.
We support this interpretation by reproducing our results with quantum dynamics simulations that incorporate rf drive power, charge noise, and temperature.

experiments.text: 作者对器件 A 进行了约 1.5×10^4 次连续测量，每次积分时间 4.5 µs，总时长 67 ms，并扫描面外磁场 B⊥ 和 V_QD2 以研究干涉环磁通依赖 [S3.p1]。器件 A 的相关区间在 B∥≈1.8 T 和 V_WP1≈-1.832 V 附近，观测到 kurtosis 以 1.7(±0.2) mT 周期振荡，与 h/2e 磁通周期一致 [S3.p2]。作者还在器件 A 的第二次测量和器件 B 上重复了类似测量，并进行了注入准粒子、断开量子点与纳米线连接等对照实验 [S3.p11][S3.p12][S3.p13]。

evidence.quote: we tune up the TQDI and perform a sequence of nearly $1.5\times 10^{4}$ consecutive measurements of the resonator response, each with an integration time of $4.5\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolMicro s}$, thereby recording a time trace of total length $67\text{\,}\mathrm{ms}$.
For device A, the relevant regime is in the neighborhood of $B_{\parallel}=$1.8\text{\,}\mathrm{T}$$ and $V_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle WP1}}=$-1.832\text{\,}\mathrm{V}$$.
we observe oscillations in the kurtosis $K(C_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle Q}})$ of the $C_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle Q}}$ time trace with a period of $1.7(\pm 0.2)\text{\,}\mathrm{mT}$
The reproducibility of the observed phenomena is demonstrated in Sec. S6.1, where we discuss a second measurement (A2) on device A ( Fig. S8) and a measurement of device B ( Fig. S9).
First, we investigate the impact of injecting quasiparticles into the superconductor as indicated in Fig. 5 a
Our second control experiment is to completely disconnect the dots from the wire.

findings.text: 量子电容测量显示 h/2e 周期的双模分布，在最优磁通值下信噪比为 1 所需积分时间为 3.7 µs [abstract][S3.p3]。从时间轨迹中提取的两个态驻留时间在约 2 T 面内磁场下超过 1 ms，与约 3 µm 分离的 Majorana 零能模及低准粒子毒化率一致 [abstract]。作者将 h/2e 周期双模振荡和随机电报信号解释为费米子宇称的切换，并估计宇称测量误差概率约为 1% [S3.p3][S5.p1]。作者指出，这些测量本身不能确定所探测的低能态是否为拓扑态，但通过拟合平凡 Andreev 态模型，已严格约束了这类态需具备的性质 [S5.p1]。

evidence.quote: Our quantum capacitance measurements show flux h / 2 ​ e h/2e -periodic bimodality with a signal-to-noise ratio of 1 1 in 3.7 µ ​ s 3.7\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolMicro s} at optimal flux values.
we extract a dwell time in the two associated states that is longer than 1 ms 1\text{\,}\mathrm{ms} at in-plane magnetic fields of approximately 2 T 2\text{\,}\mathrm{T} .

These results are consistent with a measurement of the fermion parity encoded in a pair of Majorana zero modes that are separated by approximately 3 µ ​ m 3\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolMicro m} and subjected to a low rate of poisoning by non-equilibrium quasiparticles.
We interpret these $h/2e$ -periodic bimodal oscillations and RTS in ${\tilde{C}}_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle Q}}$ as originating from switches of fermion parity.
These measurements do not, by themselves, determine whether the low-energy states detected by interferometry are topological.
by fitting to a model of trivial Andreev states, we have tightly constrained the properties that such states would have to have in order to be consistent with our data.

limitations.text: 作者明确指出，该测量本身不能明确区分拓扑相中的 Majorana 零能模和平凡相中精细调节的低能 Andreev 束缚态 [S1.p3]。作者还指出，这些测量本身不能确定干涉测量探测到的低能态是否为拓扑态，需要另文讨论器件相图和所观测磁通依赖 RTS 的稳定性 [S5.p1]。此外，作者提到在当前器件中预期 E_M 会有显著变化，归因于有限尺寸效应导致的介观涨落 [S4.p7]。

evidence.quote: By itself, this measurement does not unequivocally distinguish between MZMs in the topological phase and fine-tuned low-energy Andreev bound states in the trivial phase
These measurements do not, by themselves, determine whether the low-energy states detected by interferometry are topological.
To fully resolve this issue, we will discuss the device’s phase diagram and the stability of the observed flux-dependent RTS in a separate publication.
Within the topological phase, we expect a substantial variation in $E_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle M}}$ in our current devices, attributable to mesoscopic fluctuations due to finite-size effects.
